short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Tangkhul: the complete Bible, with the Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, and the Spirit's in purple.

You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father. FHB is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking, so the Father's own voice is never lost in the page.

This edition is the complete Bible for Tangkhul readers — the Tangkhul Naga families of Ukhrul, across Manipur and Nagaland, and the communities living far from home who still pray in their own language.
He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you.

The Tangkhul text of this edition is in preparation. Its glossary — how this translation renders our Father, Abba and Heavenly Father in Tangkhul — is settled with native reviewers first, before any Scripture is translated. Nothing is coined ahead of that work.
Available in hardback and paperback. Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: Receive The Father. Hear His Voice. His Heart Is For You.
body: The Tangkhul Bible, part of Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB), is a color coded Bible for Tangkhul Naga readers — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
In FHB the Father's words are in blue. The Son's are in red. The Spirit's are in purple. Everything else is in black. You are never left guessing whose voice you are reading.
Tangkhul Naga families, pastors and evangelists, churches across Manipur and Nagaland, believers in Ukhrul district, and the Tangkhul diaspora — and for anyone giving a Bible to someone they love.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

faq.q: Is the Tangkhul edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Tangkhul, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Tangkhul edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Tangkhul edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Tangkhul text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Tangkhul Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/nmf.
